prompt: Create an original 90 second fingerstyle acoustic folk instrumental composition for puzzle game, strategy and patient problem solving. Mood: curious, playful, precise. Instruments: steel-string guitar, mandolin, light hand percussion. Style: alternating bass picking and a clear acoustic melody. Tempo approximately 96 BPM; C lydian. Main idea: a compact three-note motif. Use offset accents and question-and-answer motifs without dramatic shocks. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.

description.en: A gentle and melodic acoustic folk piece featuring fingerpicked guitar, bass, and light percussion, creating a serene and pleasant atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首温柔而旋律优美的原声民谣作品，以指弹吉他、贝斯和轻柔的打击乐器为主，营造出宁静宜人的氛围。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
